title: Ninazima kila kitu ambacho sio sasa

text.I turn off everything that is not now: Ninazima kila kitu ambacho sio sasa
text.I tried not to think too hard about focu: Nilijaribu kutofikiria sana juu ya kuzingatia sasa. Ikiwa nadhani "zingatia sasa!" kupita kiasi, mimi hukasirika kwa njia fulani, na haiendi vizuri.
text.The future: off. The past: off. Worry: o: Wakati ujao: imezimwa. Zamani: zimezimwa. Wasiwasi: mbali. Hadithi zinazofikiriwa: zimezimwa.
text.So it is the opposite way round, but I f: Kwa hivyo ni kinyume chake, lakini niligundua kuwa kwa kushikilia picha ya kutofikiria juu ya kitu kingine chochote isipokuwa sasa, ya kuzima umeme, ninaishia kuishi "hapa na sasa" vizuri baada ya yote.
text.These days, this is what I want to remem: Siku hizi, hii ndiyo ninayotaka kukumbuka.
text.I want to try Hermes Agent, but I do not: Nataka kujaribu Wakala wa Hermes, lakini sijui inafanya nini
text.I like the smell while waiting on Japane: Ninapenda harufu wakati nikingojea kwenye majukwaa ya treni ya chini ya ardhi ya Kijapani
